controls.title: Hardware inventory
controls.objective: An inventory of hardware assets is maintained and matches what is found on the network.

evidence.description: Comparison against a network discovery scan

questions.text: Percentage of devices found by a network discovery scan that are present in the hardware inventory
questions.guidance: Run or obtain a recent discovery scan and reconcile with the inventory.

questions.text: Does the inventory record owner, location, and criticality for each device?
questions.guidance: Partial: some fields missing for more than 10 percent of devices.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Software and service inventory
controls.objective: An inventory of software, systems, and supplier services is maintained.

questions.text: Is there an inventory of software, systems, and cloud or supplier services, updated in the last 6 months?
Number of software titles found on a sample of 10 endpoints that are not in the inventory
questions.guidance: Compare installed software on sampled endpoints with the inventory.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Network and data flow documentation
controls.objective: Current diagrams show authorized network connections and data flows, including external connections.

questions.text: Are network and data flow diagrams current (updated in the last 12 months) and do they show every external connection?
questions.guidance: Partial: diagrams exist but outdated or missing external links.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Data inventory and classification
controls.objective: Designated data types are inventoried, classified, and prioritized by impact.

questions.text: Is there an inventory of designated data types (for example personal, financial, operational) with a classification and owner for each?
questions.guidance: Partial: classification scheme exists but not applied to an inventory.

questions.text: Are systems prioritized by the classification of data they hold and their impact on the mission?

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Vulnerability management
controls.objective: Assets are scanned for vulnerabilities on a schedule and critical findings are remediated within a defined time.

questions.text: Days since the last authenticated vulnerability scan of internal systems
Number of critical-severity vulnerabilities open longer than 30 days
questions.guidance: Count from the latest scan or tracker.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Cyber risk assessment
controls.objective: Threats, likelihoods, and impacts are assessed and used to prioritize risk responses.

questions.text: Has a cybersecurity risk assessment recording threats, likelihood, and impact been completed in the last 12 months?
questions.guidance: Partial: completed more than 12 months ago.

questions.text: Does the organization receive threat intelligence from at least one sharing source (for example an ISAC or government advisory feed)?
questions.guidance: Ask which feeds are used and who reads them.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29
